subject: CSA control pack assembly & ambassador handoff
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@zephyrsec.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Zephyr Security Procurement <procurement@zephyrsec.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: CSA control pack request — single-package delivery

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Zephyr's audit team has kicked off the CSA review and they'd like a single, consolidated "control pack" for the CAIQ items we've prioritized (data protection, key management, runtime logs). Our auditor prefers a folder with:

- brief answer per control (1–2 lines)
- evidence artifact (config screenshots, policy PDFs, log extracts)
- control owner and contact

Can your team deliver a first draft within 5 business days? Also please include a simple owner roster so we can route follow-ups to the right person.

If helpful, we can accept a Google Drive folder + a zipped binder. Procurement is CC'd for DocuSign / PO details.

Best,
Claire O'Neill
Senior Security Engineer
Zephyr Security

---
Attachment: zephyr-csa-priority-list.pdf (pdf)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@zephyrsec.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA control pack request — single-package delivery

Claire — thanks, we can do that. Kicking this over to our evidence owners and control ambassadors. Proposed plan:

1) Assemble a "binder" using the attached template with one folder per control.
2) Populate concise answers + one representative artifact per control.
3) Export a small sample of runtime logs and a sanitized config screenshot for the key-management controls.
4) Deliver a Drive link and a zipped binder by EOD Tuesday (5 business days).

Monica, Grace, Karthik — can each of you pick two controls to own this sprint? I attached a blank roster (CSV) to populate owner, slack, and backup.

I will own the delivery and send the Drive link. Any blockers, flag them in this thread or open SECOPS-412 in Jira.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of InfoSec Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: caiq-control-ambassador-roster.csv (csv)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA control pack request — single-package delivery

David — I'll own controls related to key management (CM-1, CM-2) and data encryption-at-rest (DPR-3). Quick status and asks:

- I have the KMS rotation policy and the HSM integration diagram ready. Attaching the policy PDF and a sanitized screenshot of the KMS console.
- For runtime logs, I need the ops team to run a short extraction with the script below (we should hand this off to Infra).

Requested infra step (one-liner): run runtime-log-extraction.sh with date range 2027-04-01 to 2027-04-30; sanitize PII; return compressed tar.gz.

I'll populate the binder template with control answers and link artifacts in a Drive folder once I have the log extract.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: evidence-binder-template.pdf (pdf), runtime-log-extraction.sh (bash)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA control pack request — single-package delivery

Looping in a couple notes from operations:

- Ops confirmed they can run the extraction and will sanitize logs as requested. They asked for a runbook entry so the extraction is repeatable; I'll draft one and attach it to the Drive.
- I've started filling out the crosswalk (caiq-crosswalk-v3.xlsx) with references to our policies and numbering that maps to the auditor's priority list.
- ETA: first draft of the binder + Drive link by COB Tuesday (2027-05-18).

Karthik — can you pick up the control that covers vulnerability management evidence (VM set)? We should include scan results and the remediation ticket list.

Grace O'Connor
Director, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: caiq-crosswalk-v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Claire O'Neill <claire.oneill@zephyrsec.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Zephyr Security Procurement <procurement@zephyrsec.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CSA control pack request — single-package delivery

Thanks David, Monica, Grace — that plan works for us. A couple of quick asks to avoid back-and-forth after you deliver:

- Please include a short README in the Drive folder that explains what each artifact is and which controls it maps to.
- If any logs include user-identifiable fields, note that a sanitized rule was applied (e.g., "user_id -> hashed") in the README.
- For VM evidence, include the scan date, scanner name/version, and a link to remediation tickets (or Jira ids).

If you can attach the Drive link in your delivery email we will start our internal review and escalate any clarifying questions to the control owners listed in your roster.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Claire O'Neill
Senior Security Engineer
Zephyr Security

---
Note: procurement confirmed PO flow and will await your invoice after acceptance.
